subject: Invoice delivery options and GST evidence for Green Harbor
messages:
From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@greenharbor.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: po-team@greenharbor.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Invoice delivery and GST evidence for Redwood usage (Green Harbor)

Hi Tessa,

We're getting ready to onboard Redwood for our freight-optimization pilot. AP has a few requirements before we can start invoice processing:

- We need invoices to include a GST component with a clear tax breakdown (taxable base, GST amount) in both the human-readable PDF and the machine-readable XML (if you push e-invoices).
- We prefer automated delivery into our billing portal (SFTP or API), but as a fallback AP will accept PDF copies via email to ap@greenharbor.com.
- Please confirm whether Redwood can:
  * emit an e-invoice XML schema (we use Peppol-like fields)
  * push invoices to our portal (SFTP/HTTPS)
  * include the invoice creator/issuer name on the PDF (required for our audit)

Attached is our PO (PO-88921) and a scanned GST registration certificate for initial verification.

Can you confirm the path forward and an estimated onboarding timeline (we're aiming to go-live mid-September)?

Thanks,
Sonia Patel
Finance Operations Lead
Green Harbor Logistics

Attachments: PO-88921.pdf, GH-GST-certificate.pdf
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@greenharbor.com>
Cc: po-team@greenharbor.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery and GST evidence for Redwood usage (Green Harbor)

Hi Sonia — thanks for the PO and the GST cert. Helpful.

Short answers up front:
- Yes — we can produce both a PDF invoice and a machine-readable XML payload that includes line-level tax breakdowns.
- Yes — we can push invoices into your portal. We support SFTP, a simple push-API, and email fallback to ap@greenharbor.com.
- Yes — we can show the invoice issuer/creator name on the PDF (and include it as a field in the XML).

Options & tradeoffs (recommended path in bold):
1) Portal push (SFTP or HTTPS API) — best for automation and quickest AP reconciliation. We recommend SFTP for simple onboarding. Onboarding SLA: ~7 business days once credentials and test endpoint are provided.
2) Portal push + emailed PDF copy — typical for customers who want human receipts and machine ingestion.
3) Email-only PDF — acceptable for small volumes but manual and prone to delays.

I've attached a sample XML invoice (sample-invoice.xml) showing our tax fields. If you can provide a test SFTP account or the API endpoint (and a test credential), we can start a sandbox push next week.

Quick Qs: can you confirm the AP contact we should register for portal access and the exact PO mapping rules (should we map Redwood's "account_code" to your PO number field)?

I'll loop in our billing onboarding team internally (cc'd in my next message) to handle credentials and the onboarding checklist.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sample-invoice.xml
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Invoice delivery and GST evidence — recommended portal + email copy fallback

Team — forwarding Green Harbor's request. Key asks: XML with tax breakdown, portal push (SFTP preferred), invoice creator on PDF, they attached PO-88921 and GST cert. Target go-live mid-September.

My recommended plan:
- Owner: Marissa (Billing Onboarding) — create SFTP endpoint test flow and validate sample-invoice.xml mapping (PO->account_code)
- Owner: Kimberly (Tax/VAT) — validate GST registration and confirm the tax fields we must populate for US GST-equivalent reporting (they want line-level breakdown)
- Delivery: set up portal push + email copy to ap@greenharbor.com for 30 days, then turn off email after reconciliation completes.

Onboarding checklist (attach) contains required test files, credentials, and verification steps. Please confirm resource availability — we have ~12 business days until mid-September go-live target. If we can't meet portal onboarding on time we should offer a 1-month email PDF cadence with a clear plan and manual reconciliation support.

Note: Sonia also asked that the "invoice creator" be a named person (for audit). We usually put the billing team's contact name on the PDF and an internal creator_id in the XML. Confirm if that satisfies AP's audit needs.

Thanks — Tessa

Attachments: onboarding-checklist.pdf
